profile_note: Central customization profile. Every organization-specific value used by the generators lives here. In a customer engagement, copy this repository into a private repository and edit only this file plus the record content; never commit customer values to the public template.
organization_name: TBD: Information has not been provided
business_purpose: Reference architecture assumption: a generic AWS-native Platform as a Service foundation that customers use to deploy and operate applications and SaaS workloads on AWS.
deployment_model: TBD: Information has not been provided
iac_technology: Terraform (Needs validation: default assumption, not confirmed)
management_plane: TBD: Information has not been provided. Whether a provider-hosted management plane exists, and whether it can reach customer workloads or federal information, is unconfirmed. Records depending on this answer carry Needs validation.
federal_information_types: TBD: Information has not been provided
security_contact: TBD: Information has not been provided
incident_contact: TBD: Information has not been provided
assessor: TBD: Information has not been provided
evidence_retention: TBD: Information has not been provided
trust_center_uri: TBD: URL of the FedRAMP-compatible trust center for Certification Data (CDS-CSO-UTC). Until set, the CPO carries a placeholder and preflight blocks submission.
secure_config_guide_uri: TBD: URL of the published Secure Configuration Guide (SCG-CSO-RSC). Until set, the CPO carries a placeholder and preflight blocks submission.
provider_verified_at: TBD: ISO-8601 datetime the provider verified and validated the current offering. FRC-APP-FCP requires the initial package to be verified/validated within the previous 7 days of submission. Left as TBD in the template so `sdr.py preflight` reports it as a blocker until a provider fills it.

external_assessment.note: Required for Class A (FRC-CLA-ASF, FRC-CLA-EAM). Model the alternative-framework assessment as references; do NOT store confidential reports in this repository. All values TBD in the template.
external_assessment.framework: TBD: SOC 2 Type II | FedRAMP Ready | GovRAMP | other alternative security framework
external_assessment.assessment_date: TBD: YYYY-MM-DD (must be within the previous 12 months per FRC-CLA-ASF)
external_assessment.assessor: TBD: name of the assessing organization

materials_item_schema.uri: location reference (the report itself is NOT stored in this repository)

evidence_sources.note: Optional third-party evidence sources, opt-in per customer. Off by default. Set enabled=true and point export_path at a customer-produced export (produced in the customer's own environment; this repository holds no API client or credentials). See automation/collectors/thirdparty_adapters.py.
